mathematical_review: Integral coordinates and tenth-unit windows/service permit an integer-scaled distance/time calculation. For q=100(dx²+dy²), floor sqrt(q) plus the comparison4q≥(2floor sqrt(q)+1)² computes nonnegative nearest-integer rounding. With integral coordinates no half-integer tie is possible; no binary floating-point rounding is used by this authored check.

Rounded Euclidean edges need not obey the triangle inequality. The complete undirected graph shortest path is the sound lower bound: every legal route prefix/suffix has at least that much travel. Ignoring intermediate service, waiting, capacity and visitation constraints only relaxes the problem.

For customeri, max(shortest(0,i),early_i) lower-bounds its service start. Adding its nonnegative service and shortest(i,0) lower-bounds eventual depot return. Each strict deadline violation would therefore be necessary-condition failure under this mathematical contract. Zero violations is only failure to refute feasibility.

Prefix/suffix shortest paths may use incompatible/shared intermediate visits. No concatenated shortest path is asserted to be a legal route; this does not invalidate their use as independent lower bounds.
